headline: FAR more is already BUILT than the two prior 2026-06-23 scopings assumed — both have been substantially REALIZED since. The capstone loop is GPU-GO at 1-seed (_longitudinal_develop_loop_gpu.py) and the console's /api/brain-chat endpoint + the Interact tab (leftmost, default) ALREADY SHIP. This is now mostly an ASSEMBLY + WIRING + SCALE-HORIZON job, not a frontier. The two genuine gaps: (A) lineage persists DevelopState-JSON only (not cp_connections/learned codes -> resume RE-HEARS to re-derive codes = a wall-clock tax + a fidelity caveat at long horizon) + no save_developed_brain BUNDLE is ever produced (so the console can't load a develop-loop brain yet) + the GROWTH/CONSOLIDATE stages are owner-approved STAND-INS (TierPromoter decision-only, self-replay not full-SWR); (B) the console's RICH-answer path is NOT wired (the endpoint accepts rich=True and calls chat.render_rich, but ChatBrain has NO render_rich — the rich logic lives in the separate RichAnswerComposer wrapper) + no chat-driven brain ACTIVITY feed (the [ACTIVITY] viz is gated to the nav runner only). The PAIRING SEAM = developed_brain_io.save_developed_brain(bundle) <-> the console's existing load_developed_brain bundle path: produce ONE bundle from the capstone, point the console at it, talk to it.

Finding 2026-06-23-longitudinal-develop-loop-GPU-GO.md: 4 days, vocab 6->24, facts 2->11, recall 1.0, retention 1.0, moat 0-FA, corr(M,C) 0.894 (REAL learning), persists+resumes (+5 days on a resume), frozen-brain anti-cheat holds. Per-day ~133s -> compressed-week ETA 15.6 min, month ~1 hr, year ~13.5 hr LOCAL.
A_capstone.wall_clock_VRAM: Per-day ~2.2 min (the findings' anchor, smoke vocab=24). LOCAL, comfortably <24 GB (the 320-stream cortex ~10K neurons / ~25M synapses fit on the 3090). Year ~13.5 hr = an overnight LOCAL run. CONFIRMED: cloud is NOT needed (per feedback_long_local_runs_ok_confirm_cloud_cause — the only thing that could trigger cloud is the OPTIONAL generative-faculty 50-200M scale-up, itself likely-local).
A_capstone.persistence_DEPTH_gap: BridgeLineage.save/load persists the DevelopState payload (facts/vocab/tier/day/per-day metrics) as JSON only — it does NOT persist cp_connections (the stream cortex's learned synaptic weights). On resume the loop RE-HEARS the cumulative vocab to RE-DERIVE the codes (`_longitudinal_develop_loop_gpu.develop_gpu` resume branch, lines ~324-330: 'cheap stand-in for loading the bridge's synaptic store; the GPU full-persist of cp_connections is a follow-on'). At a LONG horizon this re-hear is a per-resume wall-clock tax AND a fidelity drift risk. The fix exists in-project: BridgeLineage.export_shards / save_checkpoint persist cp_connections; wiring the stream-cortex bridge's synapses into the lineage .h5 (vs re-hearing) is the genuine persistence build.
A_capstone.bundle_gap: developed_brain_io.save_developed_brain (writes a self-contained brain.json + grounded_codes.npz + facts.json + lineage/ bundle the console can --load) is NEVER CALLED by the develop loop OR _self_knowledge_demo. NO brain.json bundle exists on disk (verified: `find . -name brain.json` = empty). The self-knowledge demo saves codes to a flat _self_knowledge_grounded_codes.json (229KB, ON DISK) — a DIFFERENT artifact the console loads via the 'self-knowledge' brain source, not the bundle path. So a develop-loop-developed brain CANNOT be loaded by the console yet (only the self-knowledge codes + the tiny-demo can).
A_capstone.standins: GROWTH = TierPromoter DECISION + lineage growth-event (the real neuron-count arch rebuild + weight-transfer is a heavy GPU follow-on; auto_grow_chat.py orchestration runs but with mock train/transfer). CONSOLIDATE = the agent's self-replay + OLD-fact retention re-test (owner-approved; full-SWR-on-the-conv-bridge deferred because consolidation_trainer.py hard-imports cupy AND builds a DIFFERENT direction-vocab bridge).

So 'talk to the developed brain' is DONE as a TUI; the gap is only the BUNDLE the loop should produce (so the TUI/console can load a develop-loop brain, not just the self-knowledge codes).

Wraps brain_chat_tui.ChatBrain (reuse-by-import, NO sim/ edit), session-cached + kept WARM (cache key (session,brain,renderer)), GPU-light by default (_default_brain_renderer picks qwen only if a free CUDA GPU + cupy, else the GPU-free stub). brain source in {tiny-demo, self-knowledge, a developed-brain bundle DIR}. B_console.rich_answer_gap: RICH-answer is NOT wired into the console. The endpoint ACCEPTS rich=True and calls `chat.render_rich(gate_svo)` IF hasattr(chat,'render_rich') — but ChatBrain has NO render_rich method (the rich multi-sentence logic lives in the SEPARATE RichAnswerComposer wrapper, which has a different `.answer(question)->dict` API, not a `render_rich(svo)`). So today the endpoint silently falls back to the single-fact render for rich=True. Wiring rich = (i) construct a RichAnswerComposer around the cached ChatBrain (session-cached like the ChatBrain), (ii) call rich.answer(message) -> {answer, abstained, facts, n_sentences} and surface it. NO sim/ edit (RichAnswerComposer is import-clean).

The CHAT path returns answers, not activity frames. So 'show the brain's live activity during a conversation' is NEW work. Cheapest cut = a per-turn SEMANTIC strip (recalled SVO + gate decision answered/ABSTAINED + the conceptual pathway parser->composer/KB->cleanup->render) under each answer — already mostly carried by the endpoint's recalled_svo/abstained/verified fields; a later upgrade streams real cp_firing_states off the co-resident composer bridge.

how_they_pair: The console LOADS + TALKS to the capstone's developing brain through ONE shared artifact: developed_brain_io's brain.json BUNDLE. A1 has the develop loop SAVE a bundle at the end of (or periodically during) a run; B2 has the console LIST + SELECT bundles; the EXISTING /api/brain-chat already loads a bundle (is_developed_brain_bundle/load_developed_brain) and B1 makes the answer rich. So the owner: (1) launches the develop loop from the console's Lab tab (job 1) — the brain develops over simulated days, PERSISTING bundles; (2) opens the Interact tab (job 3) and picks the developed brain (a day-N bundle), then TALKS to it (rich multi-sentence, gate->render->verify, multi-turn anaphora, the moat abstaining on the untaught); (3) watches the brain's activity (job 2) — the per-turn semantic strip / 3D region pulses. The day-0-vs-day-N comparison (talk to an early bundle vs a late one) is the 'watch + talk to a brain developing over time' deliverable, end-to-end on the console. NOTE: the cheap cut works TODAY with the tiny-demo + the self-knowledge codes (both already loadable); A1's bundle is what makes the CAPSTONE's developing brain the thing the owner talks to.

capstone: HELD-OUT probe (never-taught-but-in-distribution): development = generalization not memorization; the loop already has probe_heldout per day.

RETENTION / no-replay control: a yoked loop with consolidation OFF MUST catastrophically forget while the consolidated loop retains (the loop tracks retention_acc; the no-replay arm is the load-bearing contrast — currently the FROZEN-BRAIN arm covers 'is learning load-bearing', the no-replay arm is the 'is consolidation load-bearing' to ADD at A2).
FROZEN-BRAIN control (plasticity OFF): the brain hears the stream but learns nothing -> competence must NOT rise (BUILT — do_frozen arm, frozen_anticheat_ok).
PERSISTENCE-RESUME control: reload the lineage -> the brain resumes its developed state + continues (BUILT — do_resume arm).
MOAT-never-loosens: 0 false-accepts on untaught cues across ALL days (BUILT — moat_clean).
PERMUTED-curriculum (ADD at A2): same facts in scrambled day-order -> equivalent final competence (cumulative), different per-day trajectory.
console: ABSTENTION is a first-class boolean surfaced distinctly (BUILT — the '∅ moat fired' note) so the owner SEES the no-confab moat.

RICH-answer per-sentence VERIFY: each gathered sentence's re-parsed SVO must match the brain's store; a confabulated sentence is DROPPED (BUILT in RichAnswerComposer's adversarial confab-drop check — preserve it through the endpoint wiring so the moat EXTENDS to multi-sentence).
the moat probe chip ('who wrote romeo and juliet?') stays — a one-click demonstration the brain abstains on what the LLM knows but it was not taught (the firewall, made visible).

honest_caveats: The develop-loop GROWTH + CONSOLIDATE stages are owner-approved STAND-INS (decision-only growth, self-replay not full-SWR). The development SIGNAL (vocab/facts/retention) is real + validated; the structural-growth + full-SWR-consolidation are the heavier A4/follow-on builds.
Resume currently RE-HEARS to re-derive codes (not loads cp_connections) — fine at the smoke horizon, a wall-clock + fidelity concern at a long horizon (A3 fixes it).

The output is TERSE SVO under the brain's own renderer; the off-bridge Qwen faculty gives fluent prose (GPU). The rich path (B1) is the multi-sentence upgrade; both keep the moat by per-sentence VERIFY.
1-seed GPU-GO only so far; the standing 6-seed gate applies before any 'works at scale' claim (A2).
The free-generation distribution-growth is the one piece that hit a scale wall (C2 in-band); it is OPTIONAL (A5) and decoupled from the development metric.
